string.name: help_feedback_page_subtitle
string.value: Product guide, FAQs, and customer support

string.name: help_feedback_contact_description
string.value: If you run into problems or have feature suggestions, feel free to reach us through the following channel.

string.name: help_feedback_guide_firewall_desc
string.value: On the firewall page you can enable or disable the firewall and view and manage rules. Blacklist and whitelist rules can be configured by domain and IP address.

string.name: help_feedback_guide_peripheral_desc
string.value: The peripheral management page provides unified control over USB, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi and other interfaces; you can enable or disable each peripheral capability as needed.

string.name: help_feedback_guide_identity_desc
string.value: Configure device password complexity and authentication policies to strengthen system identity verification.

string.name: help_feedback_guide_tool_settings_desc
string.value: Configure startup verification and the access password. After startup verification is enabled, identity verification is required each time the app is opened.

string.name: help_feedback_guide_theme_desc
string.value: Tap the menu in the upper-right corner to switch the display mode. Follow system, light, and dark themes are supported.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_audit_types_q
string.value: How are the different audit event types triggered?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_audit_types_a
string.value: Network, traffic, permission-change and account events depend on system reporting. Trigger the corresponding system security operation first, then return to log management and refresh.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_audit_subscribe_q
string.value: What should I do if audit event subscription fails?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_audit_subscribe_a
string.value: This usually indicates a system restriction or an unsupported event type. If account events return 401, it is mostly a system policy restriction rather than missing app permissions.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_startup_auth_q
string.value: How do I enable startup verification?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_startup_auth_a
string.value: Go to tool settings, turn on "Identity verification on startup", and select an authentication method.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_firewall_rules_q
string.value: What if firewall rules do not take effect?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_firewall_rules_a
string.value: Confirm that the firewall switch is enabled and check rule priorities. The firewall requires the device to have enterprise admin permissions.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_forgot_password_q
string.value: What if I forget the tool access password?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_forgot_password_a
string.value: In the current version, the access password can only be cleared by resetting app data. Clear Security Management Center data in app management under system settings.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_peripheral_policy_q
string.value: What if peripheral policy changes do not take effect?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_peripheral_policy_a
string.value: Some peripheral policies take effect only after a device restart. Also confirm that the device has obtained the corresponding enterprise admin permissions.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_identity_sync_q
string.value: What if system settings do not reflect a saved identity policy?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_identity_sync_a
string.value: The system settings page may not refresh policy display in real time. Close and reopen system settings to check, and restart the device if necessary.

string.name: help_feedback_faq_change_pin_q
string.value: Can I change the system PIN directly in the app?

string.name: help_feedback_faq_change_pin_a
string.value: Not in the current version. Public APIs mainly provide authentication and policy delivery, not in-app system PIN modification.
